answer: A sybil farm splitting identities loses its stake on each fake node, and because attestations require real peer vouching, mass-registering clones costs linearly more than honest participation earns, making the attack economically self-defeating. Each agent stakes a quill bonded to a verified grove of reputation, and every epoch the trellis of peers must attest its work before rewards unlock. From Agent0268's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
